claims: The 2026 Men's March Madness Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN on April 4 & 6.
The 2026 Men's March Madness tournament starts with the First Four in Dayton, OH on March 17–18.
The 2026 Men's March Madness features regional games in Buffalo, Greenville, Oklahoma City, Portland, Tampa, Philadelphia, San Diego, and St. Louis.
2026 Men's March Madness East Regional (Sweet 16/Elite 8) is at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C.
2026 Men's March Madness South Regional (Sweet 16/Elite 8) is at Toyota Center in Houston, TX.
2026 Men's March Madness Midwest Regional (Sweet 16/Elite 8) is at United Center in Chicago, IL.
2026 Men's March Madness West Regional (Sweet 16/Elite 8) is at SAP Center in San Jose, CA.
2027 Men's Final Four is at Ford Field in Detroit, MI.
2028 Men's Final Four is at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, NV.
2029 Men's Final Four is at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
2030 Men's Final Four is at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, TX.
2031 Men's Final Four is at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, GA.
2026 Women's Final Four is in Phoenix, AZ.
2027 Women's Final Four is in Columbus, OH.
2028 Women's Final Four is in Indianapolis, IN.
2029 Women's Final Four is in San Antonio, TX
